entities.note: 5x5 sprite at rows 37-41, cols 19-23 on the first frame: colour-9 body, a colour-11 eye on the side it faces, colour-5 outline; occupies one 6x6 cell of a 6-px lattice; steps 6 px sideways and 'falls' UPWARD on screen (inverted gravity)

colour-10 empty space: the corridor the player stands in (rows 37-62, cols 13-53), the one-cell opening above-right (rows 30-36, cols 43-47) and the chambers above; the player can only enter colour-10 cells
6x6 grey cells with a colour-3 dot pattern; side bands cols 0-12 and 54-63, the top band rows 0-12, the shelf rows 30-36; block sideways steps and stop falls

breakable blocks: 5x5 colour-14 squares with colour-3 corner pixels, a row of 4 at rows 13-17 cols 31-53 and 3 at rows 1-5 cols 13-29 on the first frame; solid like a wall until clicked, then they vanish

the goal: a colour-7 diamond with colour-5 outline in the same 5x5 sprite style as the player; OFF-SCREEN at the start (grid (3,7), far above along the left wall), seen only after the camera scrolls up
a full-width wall of colour-15 bars (with colour-5 seams) that starts below the visible screen and rises one cell (6 px) every second non-falling step; reaching the player's row loses
row 63: black at the start; one white(15) pixel from the left per action spent (64 actions at L1)

rules.note: step one cell left (eye flips to the left side); costs 1 action
step one cell right; costs 1 action
stepping into a wall, a breakable block or the screen edge bumps: no movement, action still spent (same for ACTION4)

after a step, if the cell ABOVE (screen-up) is empty the player slides upward until something solid stops it, and the whole scene scrolls down so the player stays on screen (same for ACTION4); landing on a spike (later levels) loses
every second step that does NOT end in a fall (bumps included) the hunter wall rises one cell; falls and clicks never advance it (same for ACTION4)
the clicked breakable block disappears (costs 1 action)
if the removed block was the one the player was resting against (directly above it on screen) the player falls upward through the gap
clicking a wall, floor, the player or empty space does nothing but costs 1 action
undo: restores the whole scene to before the last action (player position, removed blocks, camera); costs 1 action

goal.note: the player must occupy the gem cell, by stepping sideways into it or falling onto it; route: through the gap at grid (7,22), then break blocks to fall upward chamber by chamber
